title: Revisions to OMB's Statistical Policy Directive No. 15: Standards for Maintaining, Collecting, and Presenting Federal Data on Race and Ethnicity

citation: Office of Management and Budget. Revisions to OMB's Statistical Policy Directive No. 15: Standards for Maintaining, Collecting, and Presenting Federal Data on Race and Ethnicity. 89 Fed Reg 22182 (March 29, 2024).
populations: People represented in United States federal race and ethnicity data
settings: United States federal statistical and administrative data collection

accessPolicy.note: The fixed federal classification standard is public United States government material. PsychSim uses only the minimum category identities and collection structure with attribution. The standard describes sociopolitical categories for statistical use, not biological or genetic categories, and supplies no psychiatric prevalence, presentation, pharmacology, treatment, or scoring rule.
